ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring platform to track coastal land usage and industrial compliance around Visakhapatnam port facilities.
ideas.title: VizagPort Compliance & Industrial Land Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying computer vision to satellite imagery for localized regional industrial compliance, which appeals directly to regional governance judges at NSRIT.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous multi-agent system coordinating port logistics, warehouse inventory, and local freight dispatch around the Vizag industrial corridor.
ideas.title: PortFlow Multi-Agent Supply Chain Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the multi-agent student support and workflow automation pattern seen in greennovation-ai-platform, offering a heavy engineering edge that judges appreciate.

ideas.pitch: Localized nutrition and wellness platform delivering meal recommendations based on regionally available produce in Andhra Pradesh.
ideas.title: Coastal Agro-Nutrition & Meal Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on the E-Foodiee win by tailoring a robust nutrition platform to regional dietary habits and locally available ingredients.

ideas.pitch: Graph intelligence and LightGBM platform for detecting anomalies and potential fraud in local smart meter electricity consumption networks.
ideas.title: Vizag Smart Grid AML & Fraud Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the graph intelligence and LightGBM pattern from Bito, demonstrating sophisticated data science methods rather than a basic wrapper.

ideas.pitch: Predictive forecasting tool using Poisson regression and weather data to predict maritime risks and incidents along the Bay of Bengal coastline.
ideas.title: Fisherman Safety & Maritime Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the robust statistical forecasting pattern of the Apart Research AI forecasting winner to solve a localized regional safety problem.
